Class ControllerUpdateLesson

java.lang.Object
guiUpdateLesson.ControllerUpdateLesson
public class ControllerUpdateLesson extends Object

Title: ControllerUpdateLesson Class.

Description: The Update Lesson Controller. This class verifies contributor ownership, validates updated values, and coordinates Lesson and Experience updates between the View and Model.

Version:
1.0 2026-10-23 Initial version after MVC refactoring
Author:
Venus Ho, Alexander Murray, Alan Shimp, Caleb Beaven, Krithik Duraisamy

  • Method Details

    • displayUpdateLesson

      public static void displayUpdateLesson(javafx.stage.Stage owner, entityClasses.User user, int lessonId, Runnable onUpdated, Runnable onCancel)

      Method: displayUpdateLesson()

      Description: Verifies access to the selected lesson, retrieves its Experiences, and opens the Update Lesson View.

      Parameters:
      owner - window that owns the Update Lesson form
      user - active contributor requesting the update
      lessonId - unique identifier of the lesson being updated
      onUpdated - operation used to refresh the calling page
      onCancel - operation used to return to the previous page

    • getExperienceById

      protected static entityClasses.Experience getExperienceById(int experienceId, int lessonId)

      Method: getExperienceById()

      Description: Retrieves an Experience for display only when it belongs to the lesson currently being updated.

      Parameters:
      experienceId - unique identifier of the requested Experience
      lessonId - unique identifier of the lesson being updated
      Returns:
      matching Experience, or null when it is unavailable

    • handleUpdateLesson

      protected static void handleUpdateLesson(javafx.stage.Stage formStage, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, String title, String category, String problemDescription, String solution, Integer experienceId, String timeText, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort, Runnable onUpdated)

      Method: handleUpdateLesson()

      Description: Validates and persists the updated Lesson Details and the selected Experience information. Lessons without Experiences can still have their Lesson Details updated.

      Parameters:
      formStage - window containing the Update Lesson form
      lesson - lesson entity being updated
      title - updated lesson title
      category - updated lesson category
      problemDescription - updated problem description
      solution - updated solution
      experienceId - selected Experience ID, or null when none exists
      timeText - updated Experience time entered as text
      whatWasDone - updated description of what was completed
      howItWasDone - updated description of how the work was completed
      teamEffort - updated description of the team's effort
      onUpdated - operation used to refresh the calling page
